title: Files in the desktop app
spec: The client offers FEATURE_FILES and decodes the id and bytes frames. ChatSession has upload_begin/upload_chunk/upload_finish, post_files and download (Unsupported without the feature; the bytes must match the announced count). SignedInSession::upload hashes a local file, sends it in MAX_CHUNK chunks and returns the file; download_to writes a new file (never overwriting) and removes it on failure; attachments(room) gives each message's files. Commands Attach { room, path }, PostFiles { room, text, files } and Save { file, size, name, to } make the worker report Uploaded, Posted (then a sync) and Saved (to the Downloads folder when to is None), and Attachments for a room whenever its messages' files change; failures name the local file or the server. The window turns a dropped file into Attach for the open room, shows uploaded files on the composer with Remove, sends them with Send even without text (PostFiles), and shows a message's files under it with Save. End to end against a running server: Alice attaches an 800 KB file and posts it; Bob sees it under her message and saves it byte for byte; saving again to the same path is refused.
